# Obsidian Plugin Review Checker

> Free, browser-local checker for Obsidian plugin developers: cross-checks manifest.json against versions.json, flags leftover sample-plugin template placeholder values, and scans source for innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML -- the patterns behind common Obsidian community plugin review delays. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
